_comment: exoguard service spec — deployed as a distinct Railway service under the pilot project. The exochain node (n0) lives in its own service, sharing only the managed Postgres plugin.

deploy._comment_startCommand: Empty — Dockerfile CMD invokes /app/entrypoint.sh. Required env vars: DATABASE_URL, EXOGUARD_IDENTITY_REF, EXOGUARD_N0_DAG_URL. All secrets (OpenRouter key, tenant webhooks) are fetched via signed MCP calls at runtime, not injected as plaintext env vars.
